name: allmiibo-web
description: Allmiibo Bluetooth-Dateimanager mit ZIP-Sicherung und Übertragungsprüfung

scripts.postbuild: node scripts/write-build-manifest.mjs root && node scripts/copy-license-notices.mjs root && npm run test:dist
scripts.postbuild:pages: node scripts/write-build-manifest.mjs pages && node scripts/copy-license-notices.mjs pages && node scripts/legacy-downloads.mjs && npm run test:dist:pages
scripts.postbuild:test1: node scripts/write-build-manifest.mjs test-app670 && node scripts/copy-license-notices.mjs test-app670 && npm run test:dist:test1
scripts.postbuild:transfer-test5: node scripts/write-build-manifest.mjs test-transfer5 && node scripts/copy-license-notices.mjs test-transfer5 && node scripts/test-production-build.mjs test-transfer5
scripts.test:release: npm test && npm run test:launcher && npm run build && npm run build:pages
